tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 点一下 3D 画面，再用键盘和鼠标学会移动、转向和靠近场景。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Click the 3D view, then learn to move, turn, and approach the scene with the keyboard and mouse.
tutorialTasks.title: 点一下 3D 主视口
tutorialTasks.message: 先在编辑器中央找到显示场景的 3D 画面，用鼠标左键在画面空白处点一下。这样后面的按键和鼠标操作才会控制这个画面。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Find the 3D scene view in the center of the editor and left-click an empty spot inside it. This lets the next keyboard and mouse actions control that view.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 点击中央的 3D 画面即可，不需要点中任何物体。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Click anywhere inside the central 3D view; you do not need to click an object.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 编辑器确认 3D 画面已准备接收操作。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The editor confirms that the 3D view is ready to receive input.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 点一下 3D 画面，再用键盘和鼠标学会移动、转向和靠近场景。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Click the 3D view, then learn to move, turn, and approach the scene with the keyboard and mouse.
tutorialTasks.title: 向前或向后移动
tutorialTasks.message: 保持鼠标在 3D 画面里，按住 W 或 S 片刻。W 会让视角向前移动，S 会让视角向后移动。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Keep the mouse over the 3D view and hold W or S briefly. W moves the view forward and S moves it backward.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 如果画面没变，先再点一下 3D 画面，然后按住 W 或 S，直到场景看起来更近或更远。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: If nothing changes, click the 3D view again, then hold W or S until the scene looks nearer or farther away.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到 W 或 S 真正改变了视角位置。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: W or S actually changes the view position.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 点一下 3D 画面，再用键盘和鼠标学会移动、转向和靠近场景。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Click the 3D view, then learn to move, turn, and approach the scene with the keyboard and mouse.
tutorialTasks.title: 向左或向右移动
tutorialTasks.message: 在 3D 画面已经能接收按键的情况下，按住 A 或 D 片刻。A 向左移动，D 向右移动。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: With the 3D view active, hold A or D briefly. A moves left and D moves right.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 观察场景中物体的相对位置，确认它们整体向另一侧移动了。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Watch the objects in the scene and confirm that they shift together toward the opposite side.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到 A 或 D 真正改变了视角位置。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: A or D actually changes the view position.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 点一下 3D 画面，再用键盘和鼠标学会移动、转向和靠近场景。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Click the 3D view, then learn to move, turn, and approach the scene with the keyboard and mouse.
tutorialTasks.title: 向上或向下移动
tutorialTasks.message: 在 3D 画面中按住 Q 或 E 片刻。Q 会让视角向下移动，E 会让视角向上移动。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Hold Q or E briefly while the 3D view is active. Q moves the view down and E moves it up.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 如果 Q 或 E 没有反应，先点一下 3D 画面再重试。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: If Q or E does nothing, click the 3D view once and try again.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到 Q 或 E 真正改变了视角高度。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: Q or E actually changes the height of the view.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 点一下 3D 画面，再用键盘和鼠标学会移动、转向和靠近场景。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Click the 3D view, then learn to move, turn, and approach the scene with the keyboard and mouse.
tutorialTasks.title: 转动视角
tutorialTasks.message: 把鼠标放在 3D 画面里，按住鼠标右键不松，同时向左、右、上或下拖动鼠标，直到看向了新的方向。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Place the pointer inside the 3D view, hold the right mouse button, and drag left, right, up, or down until the view faces a new direction.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 这一步要“按住右键并拖动”，只点一下右键不会完成。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: You must hold the right mouse button while dragging; a single right-click is not enough.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到按住鼠标右键拖动后，视角方向确实发生了变化。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: Dragging with the right mouse button actually changes the viewing direction.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 点一下 3D 画面，再用键盘和鼠标学会移动、转向和靠近场景。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Click the 3D view, then learn to move, turn, and approach the scene with the keyboard and mouse.
tutorialTasks.title: 用滚轮靠近或远离
tutorialTasks.message: 把鼠标放在 3D 画面上，向前或向后滚动鼠标滚轮，让视角实际靠近或远离场景。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Place the pointer over the 3D view and scroll the mouse wheel forward or backward so the view actually moves closer to or farther from the scene.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 连续滚动一两格，直到能看出画面距离变化。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Scroll one or two notches until the change in distance is visible.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到鼠标滚轮真正改变了视角位置。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The mouse wheel actually changes the view position.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 打开“场景管理”
tutorialTasks.message: 在编辑器的快捷按钮区找到“场景管理”，由你亲自点击它打开窗口。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Find the Scene Manager shortcut in the editor and click it yourself to open the window.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 操作展示只会指出按钮位置，不会替你完成这一步。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: The operation guide only points to the button; it will not complete this step for you.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到你亲自打开了“场景管理”窗口。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The editor detects that you opened Scene Manager yourself.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 导入一个模型
tutorialTasks.message: 在“场景管理”中点击“导入模型”，从电脑中选择一个引擎支持的模型文件，并等待它出现在场景里。这个新模型会被当作后续任务的练习对象。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: In Scene Manager, click Import Model, choose a supported model file from your computer, and wait for it to appear in the scene. This new model becomes the practice object for the next tasks.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 文件选择后请等待导入完成，不要在加载过程中重复点击。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: After choosing the file, wait for the import to finish instead of clicking repeatedly.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 一个新模型成功加入当前场景，并被教程记住。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: A new model is added to the current scene and remembered by the tutorial.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 选中刚导入的模型
tutorialTasks.message: 在场景列表中找到刚导入的模型并点击它，也可以直接在 3D 画面里点中它。选中后，属性区应该显示这个模型的信息。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Find the newly imported model in the scene list and click it, or click it directly in the 3D view. Its information should appear in the properties area.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 请选中刚才导入的那一个模型，选中其他旧物体不会完成任务。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Select the model you just imported; selecting an older object will not complete the task.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程记住的新模型已被选中。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The newly imported model remembered by the tutorial is selected.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 把位置 X 改为 1
tutorialTasks.message: 保持刚导入的模型处于选中状态。在属性区打开“变换”，找到“位置”一行的 X 输入框，把数值改为 1。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Keep the imported model selected. In the properties area, open Transform, find Position X, and change its value to 1.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 点进 X 输入框，按 Ctrl+A 选中原数字，输入 1，再按回车或点击框外。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Click the X field, press Ctrl+A, type 1, then press Enter or click outside the field.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 刚导入模型的位置 X 显示为 1。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The imported model now shows Position X as 1.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 把旋转 Y 改为 45
tutorialTasks.message: 在同一个“变换”区域里，找到“旋转”一行的 Y 输入框，把数值改为 45。这会让模型水平转过 45 度。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: In the same Transform area, find Rotation Y and change it to 45. This turns the model 45 degrees horizontally.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 输入 45 后按回车或点击框外，确保数值真正保存。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: After typing 45, press Enter or click outside the field so the value is saved.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 刚导入模型的旋转 Y 显示为 45 度。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The imported model now shows Rotation Y as 45 degrees.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 把缩放 X 改为 1.5
tutorialTasks.message: 在“变换”区域找到“缩放”一行的 X 输入框，把数值改为 1.5。只需要修改 X，其他方向保持不变。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: In the Transform area, find Scale X and change it to 1.5. Only change X; leave the other directions as they are.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 输入 1.5 后按回车或点击框外。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Type 1.5, then press Enter or click outside the field.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 刚导入模型的缩放 X 显示为 1.5。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The imported model now shows Scale X as 1.5.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 开启物理模拟
tutorialTasks.message: 保持教程模型被选中，在属性区找到“物理”或“物理模拟”，把开关打开。开关已经开启时，不要再把它关闭。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Keep the tutorial model selected, find Physics or Physics Simulation in the properties area, and turn the switch on. If it is already on, leave it on.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 开关应显示为已开启状态。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: The switch should visibly remain enabled.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程模型的物理模拟处于开启状态。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: Physics simulation is enabled for the tutorial model.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 把质量改为 10
tutorialTasks.message: 在同一个物理属性区里找到“质量”输入框，把数值改为 10。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: In the same physics properties area, find the Mass field and change its value to 10.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 如果看不到质量输入框，先确认物理模拟已经开启。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: If the Mass field is hidden, first make sure Physics Simulation is enabled.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程模型的质量显示为 10。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The tutorial model now shows Mass as 10.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型，再一步一步调整它的位置、旋转、大小和物理效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a model, then adjust its position, rotation, size, and physics one step at a time.
tutorialTasks.title: 把光照方向 X 改为 0.5
tutorialTasks.message: 回到主页面的场景光照区，找到“光照方向”的 X 输入框，把数值改为 0.5。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Return to the scene lighting area on the main page, find Light Direction X, and change it to 0.5.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 只修改 X 这一项，输入 0.5 后按回车或点击框外。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Change only X. Type 0.5, then press Enter or click outside the field.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 当前场景的光照方向 X 显示为 0.5。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The current scene now shows Light Direction X as 0.5.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 打开“节点”窗口
tutorialTasks.message: 在编辑器的快捷按钮区找到“节点”，由你亲自点击它打开节点窗口。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Find the Nodes shortcut in the editor and click it yourself to open the node window.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 操作展示只会指出按钮，自动打开的窗口不会替你完成任务。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: The operation guide only points to the button. A window opened automatically by guidance will not complete the task.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到你亲自打开了“节点”窗口。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The editor detects that you opened the Nodes window yourself.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 准备一个“开始节点”
tutorialTasks.message: 先看中间的节点编辑区。如果已经有一个写着“开始”的节点，点击它确认即可。如果没有，把左侧的“状态节点”拖到中间，再在右侧“节点类型”中选择“开始节点”。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Look at the node canvas in the middle. If one node already says Start, click it to confirm it. If none exists, drag State Node from the left into the canvas, then choose Start Node under Node Type on the right.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 整个节点图只能保留一个开始节点。如果有多个，请删掉多余的。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Keep exactly one Start node in the graph. If there are several, remove the extras.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 节点图中存在且只存在一个开始节点。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The graph contains exactly one Start node.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 放入一个“自定义”节点
tutorialTasks.message: 把左侧“宏观节点”下的“状态节点”拖到中间节点编辑区的空白位置。新节点应显示为“自定义节点”。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Drag State Node from Macro Nodes on the left into an empty spot in the middle node canvas. The new node should be a Custom node.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 请新拖入一个节点，不要只改造教程开始前已有的节点。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Drag in a new node instead of changing a node that existed before the tutorial.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 一个新的自定义节点被加入节点图并被教程记住。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: A new Custom node is added and remembered by the tutorial.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 用“选择”工具选中自定义节点
tutorialTasks.message: 确认顶部“选择”按钮亮起，然后用鼠标左键点击刚创建的自定义节点。被选中的节点会显示明显的高亮边框。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Make sure Select is highlighted, then left-click the Custom node you just created. The selected node receives a clear highlight border.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 这一步只点击节点，暂时不要拖动。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Click the node without dragging it yet.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程自定义节点已在“选择”模式下被你选中。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The tutorial Custom node is selected by you while the Select tool is active.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 把自定义节点拖到新位置
tutorialTasks.message: 用鼠标左键按住刚创建的自定义节点上方标题区，把它拖到中间画布的另一个位置，然后松开鼠标。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Hold the left mouse button on the title area of the Custom node you just created, drag it to another spot on the canvas, then release.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 要让节点明显移动一小段距离，只点击而没有拖动不会完成。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Move the node a visible distance. A click without dragging will not complete the task.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程记住的自定义节点位置真正发生了变化。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The remembered Custom node actually changes position.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 放入一个用来练习清除的节点
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Add a Node for Deletion Practice
tutorialTasks.message: 再把左侧的“状态节点”拖到中间空白位置。这是一个专门用来练习删除的临时节点，不要把它和其他节点连起来。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Drag another State Node from the left into an empty area. This is a temporary node used only to practice deletion, so do not connect it to anything.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 保留之前的教程自定义节点，这次要新增第二个自定义节点。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Keep the first tutorial Custom node. Add a second Custom node for this practice step.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 一个新的临时自定义节点已加入节点图。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: A new temporary Custom node is added to the graph.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 用“清除”工具删除练习节点
tutorialTasks.message: 先点击节点窗口顶部的“清除”按钮，再点击刚刚新增的临时自定义节点。它应该从画布中直接消失。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Click Clear at the top of the node window, then click the temporary Custom node you just added. It should disappear from the canvas immediately.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 操作展示会高亮正确的临时节点。不要删除开始节点或第一个自定义节点。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: The operation guide highlights the correct temporary node. Do not delete Start or the first Custom node.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程记住的临时练习节点已被删除。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The temporary practice node remembered by the tutorial is deleted.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 切回“选择”工具
tutorialTasks.message: 删除练习节点后，再点击顶部的“选择”按钮。后面需要用选择工具连接、选中和继续编辑节点。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: After deleting the practice node, click Select again. You will use it to connect, select, and continue editing nodes.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: “选择”按钮应重新高亮。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: The Select button should be highlighted again.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 检测到你亲自切回了“选择”工具。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The editor detects that you switched back to Select yourself.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 把开始节点连到自定义节点
tutorialTasks.message: 先点击开始节点右侧的小圆点，再点击刚创建的自定义节点左侧小圆点。看到一条带方向的线从开始节点指向自定义节点即可。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Click the small circle on the right side of the Start node, then click the small circle on the left side of the Custom node. A directed line should point from Start to Custom.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 顺序不能反：必须从“开始”的右侧连到“自定义”的左侧。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Do not reverse the direction: connect the right side of Start to the left side of Custom.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 存在一条从教程开始节点指向教程自定义节点的正向连线。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: A forward connection runs from the tutorial Start node to the tutorial Custom node.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 打开自定义节点的内容
tutorialTasks.message: 点击刚创建的自定义节点。右侧下方应该切换到“节点内部编辑”区，后面的彩色积木会放在这里。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Click the Custom node you just created. The lower-right area should switch to its internal block editor, where the next colorful blocks will be placed.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 如果右侧显示的是“连线条件编辑”，请再点一次自定义节点。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: If the right side shows connection condition editing, click the Custom node again.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 教程自定义节点被选中，其内部积木编辑区已打开。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The tutorial Custom node is selected and its block editor is open.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 在“事件”类中放入“当进入当前节点时”积木
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Add the Entry Block from Events
tutorialTasks.message: 查找位置：左侧积木栏 → “事件”分类。打开分类后，找到写着“当进入当前节点时”的积木，把它拖到右侧的节点内部编辑区空白处。它表示流程刚进入这个节点时，执行一次放在里面的动作。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Where to find it: left block toolbox > Events category. Open Events, find the block labeled "When entering this node," and drag it to an empty area of the node editor on the right. It runs the actions placed inside it once when the flow enters this node.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 不要把这块积木放到连线条件编辑区。正确位置是自定义节点内部的彩色积木编辑区；这一步先只放这一块。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Do not place this block in the connection-condition editor. Use the colorful block editor inside the Custom node, and add only this block for this step.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 自定义节点内出现了“当进入当前节点时”积木。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The Custom node contains the "When entering this node" block.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 从“运动”类添加“设置对象位置”积木
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Add Set Object Position from Motion
tutorialTasks.message: 查找位置：左侧积木栏 → “运动”分类。在这个分类中，找到表面同时写着“设置对象”和“位置 X、Y、Z”的积木。把它拖到“当进入当前节点时”积木下方的“执行”空位，直到两块积木自动咬合。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Where to find it: left block toolbox > Motion category. Find the block whose face contains both "Set object" and "Position X, Y, Z." Drag it into the Execute slot under "When entering this node" until the two blocks snap together.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: “运动”分类里有多块外观相似的积木。这一步要找的是带 X、Y、Z 位置数值的那一块，不是“持续移动”积木。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Motion contains several similar-looking blocks. Choose the one with X, Y, and Z position values, not the continuous-movement block.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: “设置对象位置”积木已连接在进入动作里。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The Set Object Position block is attached inside the entry event.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 填写要移动的模型名称
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Enter the Model Name for the Starting Position
tutorialTasks.message: 在刚接好的“设置对象”积木最上方，点击“设置对象”后面的空白输入框，把第二章导入的教程模型名称完整填进去。这样积木才知道要移动哪个物体。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Click the empty name field after "Set object" in the block you just attached, then enter the full name of the tutorial model imported in Chapter 2. This tells the block exactly which object to move.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 请照着场景树里的名称原样输入，不要填模型文件路径。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Copy the name exactly as it appears in the scene tree; do not enter a file path.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 位置积木中的对象名称与第二章教程模型一致。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The object name in the position block matches the Chapter 2 tutorial model.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 把模型的起点 X 改为 -3
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Set the Starting X Position to -3
tutorialTasks.message: 在同一块“设置对象位置”积木中，把“位置 X”后面的数字改为 -3。Y 和 Z 保持 0。运行时，模型会先明显跳到左侧的起点。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: In the same Set Object Position block, change the number after Position X to -3. Keep Y and Z at 0. When the graph runs, the model will visibly jump to a starting point on the left.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 输入负号和数字 3，然后按回车或点击框外确认。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Enter minus three, then press Enter or click outside the field to confirm it.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 位置积木的 X 显示为 -3，且对象名称仍是教程模型。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The position block shows X as -3 and still targets the tutorial model.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 在“事件”类中放入“当前节点持续时”积木
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Add the Continuous Event Block from Events
tutorialTasks.message: 查找位置：左侧积木栏 → “事件”分类。找到写着“当前节点持续时”的积木，把它拖到节点内部编辑区的另一块空白位置。它表示只要流程还停留在这个节点，放在里面的动作就会不断执行。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Where to find it: left block toolbox > Events category. Find the block labeled "While this node is active" and drag it to a separate empty area of the node editor. The actions inside it repeat for as long as the flow remains in this node.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 这块积木要和“当进入当前节点时”并排放在编辑区里，不要把它塞进上一块事件积木的“执行”空位。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Place this block beside "When entering this node" in the editor. Do not put it inside the previous event block's Execute slot.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 自定义节点内出现了一块独立的“当前节点持续时”积木。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The Custom node contains a separate "While this node is active" block.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 从“运动”类添加“让对象持续移动”积木
tutorialTasks.message: 查找位置：左侧积木栏 → “运动”分类。在这个分类中，找到表面同时带有“持续移动”、“方向”和“速度”的积木。把它拖到“当前节点持续时”积木下方的“执行”空位，直到自动咬合。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Where to find it: left block toolbox > Motion category. Find the block whose face contains "continuously," "Direction," and "Speed." Drag it into the Execute slot under "While this node is active" until it snaps in.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 不要选只有 X、Y、Z 的“设置对象位置”积木。这一步要选能填写移动方向和速度的那一块。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Do not choose the Set Object Position block with only X, Y, and Z values. Choose the block that lets you set both movement direction and speed.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: “让对象持续移动”积木已连接在持续事件里。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The continuous movement block is attached inside the continuous event.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 填写要持续移动的模型名称
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Enter the Model Name for Continuous Movement
tutorialTasks.message: 在“让对象…持续移动”积木第一行的空白输入框中，再次填入第二章导入的教程模型完整名称。上一块积木负责把它放到起点，这一块负责让同一个模型动起来。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Enter the full Chapter 2 tutorial model name in the first-line name field of the continuous movement block. The first action places this model at the start, and this action makes the same model move.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 两块动作积木中的对象名称必须完全相同。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: The object names in both action blocks must match exactly.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 持续移动积木的对象名称与教程模型一致。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The continuous movement block targets the tutorial model.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 把移动方向改为“向右”
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Set the Movement Direction to Right
tutorialTasks.message: 在“让对象持续移动”积木的第二行，点击“方向”后面的下拉框，选择“向右”。运行时，模型将从 X=-3 的起点向右移动。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: On the second line of the continuous movement block, open the Direction list and choose Right. When run, the model will move right from its X=-3 starting point.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 要选的是积木表面上的“向右”，不是键盘 D 键。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Choose Right from the block itself; this step does not ask you to press the D key.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 持续移动积木的方向显示为“向右”。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The continuous movement block shows Direction as Right.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 把持续移动速度改为 2
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Set the Continuous Movement Speed to 2
tutorialTasks.message: 在同一块积木中，把“速度”后面的数字改为 2。这表示模型每秒向右移动 2 个单位，速度不会太快，可以清楚看见它在移动。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: In the same block, change the number after Speed to 2. The model will move two units to the right each second, slowly enough to see clearly.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 输入 2 后按回车或点击框外。此时模型名称应正确，方向仍是“向右”。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Enter 2, then press Enter or click outside. The model name should still be correct and Direction should still be Right.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 持续移动积木已指向教程模型，方向为向右，速度为 2。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The movement block targets the tutorial model, points Right, and has Speed set to 2.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和彩色积木带来的效果。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Make the model imported in Chapter 2 jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so you can see the node logic working.
tutorialTasks.title: 点击“运行”，看模型动起来
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Click Run and Watch the Model Move
tutorialTasks.message: 点击节点窗口上方的“运行”按钮一次。按下后，教程模型应先跳到 X=-3 的起点，然后以每秒 2 个单位的速度持续向右移动。任务在你亲自点击“运行”时立即通过，不等待运行结果。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Click Run at the top of the node window once. The tutorial model should jump to X=-3 and then keep moving right at two units per second. The task completes immediately when you click Run yourself; it does not wait for the run result.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 点击后可以看主视口中的模型。即使后面出现运行错误，也不会阻止这个点击任务通过。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Watch the model in the main viewport after clicking. A later run error does not prevent this click task from passing.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 你亲自点击了节点窗口上方的“运行”按钮。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: You click the Run button at the top of the node window yourself.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第四章：让 AI 帮你创作
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 4: Create with AI
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 使用右侧的“包菜答疑”，学会把需求说清楚，让 AI 回答问题、修改现有内容和增加新逻辑。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Use Cabbage Assistant on the right and learn to write clear prompts for questions, edits, and new logic.
tutorialTasks.title: 点击“包菜答疑”的输入框
tutorialTasks.message: 在编辑器右侧找到“包菜答疑”，点击最下方的大输入框，让光标出现在输入框里。接下来的三步都在这里输入“提示词”。提示词就是你写给 AI 的具体要求。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Find Cabbage Assistant on the right and click the large input box at the bottom so the text cursor appears. The next three steps use this box. A prompt is the specific request you write for the AI.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 这一步只需要点击输入框，不用立刻发送。写提示词时，尽量说明“要处理什么、希望得到什么结果、哪些内容不要改”。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Only click the input box; do not send anything yet. A useful prompt says what to work on, the result you want, and what must stay unchanged.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: 你亲自点击了“包菜答疑”输入框。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: You click the Cabbage Assistant input yourself.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第四章：让 AI 帮你创作
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 4: Create with AI
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 使用右侧的“包菜答疑”，学会把需求说清楚，让 AI 回答问题、修改现有内容和增加新逻辑。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Use Cabbage Assistant on the right and learn to write clear prompts for questions, edits, and new logic.
tutorialTasks.title: 向 AI 询问一个问题
tutorialTasks.message: 在输入框中写一句只请 AI 解释、不要修改内容的提示词，然后点击“发送”。说清楚你想了解什么、指的是哪个节点或积木，并写上“只解释，不要修改”。发送后等待 AI 真正返回回答。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Write a prompt that asks the AI to explain something without changing it, then click Send. Say what you want to understand, which node or block you mean, and include "explain only; do not modify." Wait for a real answer.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 示例：请解释教程模型为什么会先移动到 X=-3，再持续向右移动。只解释，不要修改节点图。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Example: Explain why the tutorial model first moves to X=-3 and then keeps moving right. Explain only; do not modify the node graph.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: “包菜答疑”收到询问提示词，并成功返回了一条回答。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: Cabbage Assistant receives a question prompt and successfully returns an answer.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第四章：让 AI 帮你创作
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 4: Create with AI
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 使用右侧的“包菜答疑”，学会把需求说清楚，让 AI 回答问题、修改现有内容和增加新逻辑。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Use Cabbage Assistant on the right and learn to write clear prompts for questions, edits, and new logic.
tutorialTasks.title: 让 AI 修改现有内容
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Ask the AI to Modify Existing Content
tutorialTasks.message: 在输入框中写一句修改要求，然后点击“发送”。提示词里要说清楚：要改哪个内容、它现在是什么、要改成什么，以及哪些内容必须保持不变。等待 AI 真正完成并保存修改。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Write an edit prompt and click Send. Clearly name what to change, its current value, the new value, and what must remain unchanged. Wait until the edit is actually applied and saved.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 示例：请把教程模型持续向右移动的速度从 2 改为 4，只修改速度，其他节点和积木保持不变。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Example: Change the tutorial model's continuous rightward movement speed from 2 to 4. Change only the speed; keep every other node and block unchanged.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: AI 已经成功修改并保存了当前节点图。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The AI successfully applies and saves one node-graph edit.

tutorialTasks.chapterTitle: 第四章：让 AI 帮你创作
tutorialTasks.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 4: Create with AI
tutorialTasks.chapterSummary: 使用右侧的“包菜答疑”，学会把需求说清楚，让 AI 回答问题、修改现有内容和增加新逻辑。
tutorialTasks.chapterSummaryEn: Use Cabbage Assistant on the right and learn to write clear prompts for questions, edits, and new logic.
tutorialTasks.title: 让 AI 增加一段新逻辑
tutorialTasks.titleEn: Ask the AI to Generate New Logic
tutorialTasks.message: 最后，在输入框中写一句“增加新内容”的提示词，然后点击“发送”。说清楚要新建什么、从哪里开始连接、最后要得到什么结果，以及哪些原有内容要保留。请使用“增加”或“补充”这类说法，不要让 AI 重做整张节点图。
tutorialTasks.messageEn: Finally, write a prompt that adds new logic and click Send. Say what to create, where to connect it, the result you want, and which existing content must remain. Use words such as "add" or "extend" instead of asking the AI to rebuild the whole graph.
tutorialTasks.suggestion: 示例：请在当前节点图中增加一个结束节点，并把当前自定义节点连接到结束节点，保留已有节点和积木。
tutorialTasks.suggestionEn: Example: Add an End node to the current node graph and connect the current Custom node to it. Keep all existing nodes and blocks.
tutorialTasks.completionCriteria: AI 已成功增加并保存新逻辑。所有教程修改都会保留，不会重置项目。
tutorialTasks.completionCriteriaEn: The AI successfully adds and saves new logic. All tutorial changes remain in the project; nothing is reset.

tutorialChapters.chapterTitle: 第一章：第一次看见世界
tutorialChapters.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 1: See the World for the First Time
tutorialChapters.chapterSummary: 聚焦主视口，用键盘和鼠标学会移动、旋转摄像机。
tutorialChapters.chapterSummaryEn: Focus the viewport and learn to move the camera with the keyboard and mouse.

tutorialChapters.chapterTitle: 第二章：把物体放进世界
tutorialChapters.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 2: Put an Object into the World
tutorialChapters.chapterSummary: 打开场景管理，导入一个模型并精确调整它的属性。
tutorialChapters.chapterSummaryEn: Open Scene Manager, import a tutorial model, and adjust it precisely.

tutorialChapters.chapterTitleEn: Chapter 3: Bring the World to Life
tutorialChapters.chapterSummary: 让第二章导入的模型先跳到起点，再持续向右移动，亲眼看到节点和积木的效果。
tutorialChapters.chapterSummaryEn: Make the Chapter 2 model jump to a starting point and then keep moving right, so the result is easy to see.

tutorialChapters.chapterTitle: 第四章：让 AI 帮你创作
tutorialChapters.chapterSummary: 使用右侧的“包菜答疑”，学会把需求说清楚，让 AI 回答问题、修改现有内容和增加新逻辑。
tutorialChapters.chapterSummaryEn: Use Cabbage Assistant on the right and learn to write clear prompts for questions, edits, and new logic.
